text:
lee: heads-up: invoice-preview jumped ~9% for several customers right after we enabled sticky-routing v2 at 01:10 UTC. mid-size streaming + bursty tenants.
sam: can you attach the preview snippet? tokens vs requests?
lee: tokens. sample preview: tenant=studio-x, route=sticky-v2, tokens_prev=84200, tokens_now=91580 (+8.8%).
nina: likely duplicate meter events on fallback/fast-retry. proxy emits attempted+final events and our ingest dedupe keys on req_id which proxy sometimes rewrites for retries.
billing: want to avoid surprise invoices. Can we pause finalization for affected tenants until we reconcile?
sam: propose three-part action: (1) proxy emits stable header x-canonical-id for retries (canary tomorrow), (2) ingest uses canonical id to dedupe within 10s window, (3) console: add "invoice hold" flag per-tenant that prevents final invoice commit and surfaces an audit note.
lee: agree. also add metric duplicate_deduped_count and an alert if >0.5% tokens in 1h.
ingest-bot: created anomaly ticket AM-176880; scheduled proxy canary 03:00 PDT.
billing: we'll hold invoices for tenants with previewDelta>5% and route=sticky-v2. finance notified.
lee: will follow up with rollout plan + patch PR.
